meaning: When an AI chatbot states something false or made up as if it were true.
clues: It is linked to how an AI system makes an answer.
It can affect what the system says.
The answer sounds sure of itself but includes facts that were made up.
You should check important answers against a trusted source.
It has two words, and the second starts with H.
assumes: AI bias can shape system outputs.
A prompt guides what an AI system produces.

decoys.meaning: Unfair results from an AI system, often due to its training examples.
The question or instruction a person gives to an AI system.
Examples used to teach an AI system how to do a task.

exchange.text: A confident voice was never proof in the old days. We checked a book, a bill, or a second person then, too.
